section.title: Template version
section.digestMismatch: The project was created by a Studio build with different contents of this template version: comparing with the template may show extra edits.
section.upToDate: This is the latest template version.
section.revertConfirmText: Files the update changed go back to their previous content and the project returns to version {{version}}. Edits you made after the update stay: where they overlap the update, the file is left alone.
section.revertKept_one: {{count}} file left as is: you edited it after the update
section.revertKept_other: {{count}} files left as is: you edited them after the update
section.markers: These files still contain conflict markers (<<<<<<<) — resolve them, otherwise the document won't build:

compare.title: Compare with the template
compare.hint: Which template files you edited or deleted. Updates merge your edits with the template's changes.
compare.none: You haven't changed any template files.
compare.approximateHint: This file's base was reconstructed approximately: some of the "edits" may be project data (names, topic) filled in at creation.
compare.untrackHint: Template updates will no longer touch this file

card.title: Template fixes
card.text: Version {{version}} of your project's template is out.

dialog.title: Template update {{from}} → {{to}}
dialog.loading: Comparing your project with the new template version…
dialog.nothing: The update changes no project files: only the new template version applies (checks, submission profiles).
dialog.applied: The project is updated to version {{version}}
dialog.appliedMarkers: Resolve the conflicts in the marked files — they won't build until then
dialog.outdated: The project changed while you were reviewing. The preview is refreshed — please check again.
dialog.safety: Before updating, the Studio saves a project snapshot in Versions, and the update can be reverted.
dialog.selectFile: Select a file to see its changes
dialog.binary: Binary file — no diff available; you can only pick one version as a whole.

provenance.root: The comparison base was reconstructed from the project history.
provenance.approximate: The project's creation history is missing: the base was reconstructed approximately, so there may be more conflicts than actual edits.

warning.approximate_base: The comparison base was reconstructed approximately — some conflicts may be false.
warning.frozen_documents: The update changes documents frozen for signing or already signed ({{docs}}): signatures will be outdated after a rebuild. If a document is already submitted, update after the checkpoint.
warning.signature_placements: The template changed documents with placed signatures ({{docs}}): after building, check the page and position of each signature.
warning.team_project: Team project: teammates update their own projects — agree on moving to the same version.

access.filesOnly: This Studio version can't read the project data — only files are available
access.schema: The project was saved by a newer Studio{{required}}.
access.template: Template version {{version}} is not available in this Studio{{required}}.
access.updating: The project template is being updated.
access.hint: Update the Studio in Settings → About. You can return the project to an earlier snapshot in Versions.
